name: Steam Hearth
notes: Steam multiblock: runs on steam from steam input hatches, no energy or maintenance hatch. Every tiered part (machine casing, gear box, pipe casing, firebox, frame) must be the same tier: bronze (shown) or steel (Solid Steel Machine Casing and steel parts; high-pressure steam, faster). Buses are steam input/output buses. Steam furnace (Steam Hearth), 3x3x3, at least 2 machine casings; gear boxes on top, fireboxes in the middle layer and pipe casings in the base. Sharing: every hatch found during the structure check is added to each controller whose structure contains it, so steam hatches and buses in a shared wall serve both machines.
